summary: Reject non-regular up-migration catalog entries before migration SQL
details: Reject symlinks, directories and other non-regular entries ending in .up.sql with a fixed error and no partial catalog.
Preserve regular migration filenames, sorted application order and ignored unrelated entries.
Document the regular-file requirement and the operator-owned release-checksum and read-only-directory prerequisites.

compatibility.notes: No SQL or recorded migration changes. Matching non-regular entries now fail closed instead of being followed or silently ignored. Keep released migration files as regular files in the configured directory.

security: Validate entry metadata before executing migration SQL and return fixed rejection errors without operator-controlled paths. Invalid catalogs never produce a partial application list; database connection setup still precedes discovery in the current command.
limitations: Catalog discovery is not checksum authentication or protection against concurrent filesystem replacement; keep migration inputs read-only and verify their release provenance.
Runner serialization, target/checksum enforcement, worker operations and deployment/runbook qualification remain in the incomplete EVY-1206 scope.
